# doc-to-markdown

> Convert HTML and DOCX into safe, structure-preserving Markdown with headings, lists, tables and links, bounded against zip bombs, XML entities and script URLs. Python package `trysac-doc-to-markdown`, import name `doc_to_markdown`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests
